scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @kumi/runtime && npm run build --workspace @kumi/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @kumi/runtime && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/test-isolated.mjs apps/kumi/dist/test/*.test.js packages/runtime/dist/test/*.test.js apps/live-extension/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.setup: npm ci && npm run build && npm ci --prefix apps/mcp-server && npm run build --prefix apps/mcp-server
